name: ai-os
description: AI-OS: an intent-kernel desktop machine driven by a local llama.cpp model, with a real sandboxed filesystem.
author: Cary

scripts._comment:postinstall: This Electron release does not fetch its binary on install; it waits for the first require('electron'). npm test runs suites in parallel, so on a fresh clone several processes raced to unpack the same folder and three suites crashed. Fetch it once, here.
scripts._comment:debug: Opens a CDP port on localhost. Anything on this machine can then drive the renderer, so use it for development only.
scripts._comment:e2e: Starts the real application and drives it over CDP. `test` reads source; this one runs it.
scripts._comment:e2e-packaged: Same suite against the newest dist/*-portable.exe in a throwaway directory -- the only way to exercise a genuine first run.
scripts._comment:dist: Both Windows targets from one config. The portable exe keeps the user's files in AI-OS-data beside itself; the installer keeps them in %APPDATA%\ai-os.

_comment:build: Packaging config lives in electron-builder.yml, which allows comments; the schema here rejects them.
